chatgpt.desc: OpenAI's flagship AI chat tool for text generation, analysis, and creative writing
chatgpt.longDesc: ChatGPT is OpenAI's advanced AI conversational assistant built on GPT models. It handles natural conversation, questions, writing, coding, translation, and more.

claude.desc: Anthropic's safe and intelligent AI assistant, excellent at long-form analysis and code
claude.longDesc: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant series renowned for safety and long-context processing. Claude 3.5 Sonnet excels at coding and reasoning with a 200K token context window.

github-copilot.desc: AI coding assistant with real-time code completion and generation
github-copilot.longDesc: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant by GitHub and OpenAI integrated into VS Code, JetBrains, and other IDEs. It supports code completion, function generation, test writing, and code explanation.

midjourney.desc: Top-tier AI image generation tool with exceptional artistic style
midjourney.longDesc: Midjourney is one of the most popular AI image generators, known for its distinctive artistic style and high-quality output. Used via Discord with text-to-image and image-to-image capabilities.

suno.desc: AI music generation — turn text into full songs
suno.longDesc: Suno is a leading AI music platform. Just provide lyrics and style description to generate complete songs with vocals, instruments, and mixing. Supports multiple genres and languages.
suno.pricingDetail: Free 5 songs/day, Pro $10/mo (500 songs), Premier $30/mo (2000 songs)

cursor.desc: AI-first code editor with built-in intelligent coding features
cursor.longDesc: Cursor is an AI-native code editor based on VS Code with deep AI integration. Features include Tab completion, multi-file editing, AI Chat, and codebase understanding.

gemini.desc: Google's multimodal AI assistant with deep Google ecosystem integration
gemini.longDesc: Gemini is Google's AI assistant series supporting text, image, audio, and video multimodal input with seamless Google service integration.

perplexity.desc: AI search engine with cited real-time answers
perplexity.longDesc: Perplexity is an AI-powered search engine that provides real-time answers with cited sources for research and information retrieval.

runway.desc: AI video generation and editing platform with Gen-3 model
runway.longDesc: Runway is a leading AI video generation platform. Its Gen-3 Alpha model produces high-quality video content for creators and professionals.

notion-ai.desc: AI-powered note-taking and project management platform
notion-ai.longDesc: Notion AI brings artificial intelligence capabilities into Notion's notes, docs, and project management workflows.

devin.desc: Fully autonomous AI software engineer that completes coding tasks independently
devin.longDesc: Devin by Cognition Labs is the world's first fully autonomous AI software engineer. It understands complex tasks, writes code, debugs, and deploys.
